description: ELF loader W^X + NX stack (M6.5 memory hygiene). The ELF loader now maps the main user stack non-executable (honoring PT_GNU_STACK), rejects RWX PT_LOAD segments, and never leaves a shared page writable+executable. userspace/ctests/musl_wx.c loads (proving normal R-X/RW binaries still work) and spawns nx_child, which must be killed for executing on its NX stack. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_wx_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: a normal static musl binary still loads and runs after the W^X tightening
executing on the user stack now faults (stack mapped NX) and the kernel kills the process
the W^X driver ran to completion with the kernel alive

forbidden.why: the stack was executable (NX not enforced) or the child was not killed
